title_en: Shenzhen Weibang Technology Co., Ltd. v. Li Jianyi and Shenzhen Yuancheng Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. — dispute over ownership of patent rights
ruling_gist_en: In determining whether the invention-creation in question falls within the scope of 'related invention-creation' as provided in Article 12, paragraph 1, item (iii) of the Implementing Regulations of the Patent Law, the following factors shall be comprehensively considered: (1) the specific content of the departing employee's original duties or tasks assigned by the original unit; (2) the specific circumstances of the patent in question; (3) whether the original unit has carried out technical research and development activities related to the patent in question, or has a lawful source for the relevant technology; and (4) whether the patentee and the inventor can provide a reasonable explanation for the research and development process or the source of the technology. The legitimate rights of the original unit over service invention-creations shall be protected in accordance with the law, and the balance of interests among the original unit, the departing employee, and the new employer of the departing employee shall be maintained.

full_text_en:
Shenzhen Weibang Technology Co., Ltd. v. Li Jianyi and Shenzhen YuanCheng Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. — Dispute over Patent Ownership

【Ruling Summary】

In determining whether the invention-creation in question falls within the category of "related invention-creation" as stipulated in Article 12, paragraph 1, item (3) of the Implementing Regulations of the Patent Law, the following factors shall be comprehensively considered: first, the specific content of the duties performed by the departed employee at the original employer or the tasks assigned by the original employer; second, the specific circumstances of the patent in question; third, whether the original employer has conducted technical research and development activities related to the patent in question, or whether it has a legal source for the relevant technology; fourth, whether the right holder and the inventor can provide a reasonable explanation for the research and development process or the technical source of the patent in question. The legitimate rights of the original employer over service invention-creations shall be protected in accordance with the law, and the balance of interests among the original employer, the departed employee, and the new employer of the departed employee shall be maintained.

Civil Ruling of the Supreme People's Court

(2019) Supreme People's Court Min Shen No. 6342

Re-Applicant (Defendant at First Instance, Appellant at Second Instance): Li Jianyi, male, born on March 16, 1956, Han Chinese, residing in Putuo District, Shanghai.

Re-Applicant (Defendant at First Instance, Appellant at Second Instance): Shenzhen YuanCheng Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. Address: Room 501, 5th Floor, Building 5, Tianqinyuan, Jinxiu Road, Hao Yi Community, Sha Jing Street, Bao'an District, Shenzhen City, Guangdong Province (office premises).

Legal Representative: Li Jianyi, General Manager of the company.

Respondent (Plaintiff at First Instance, Appellee at Second Instance): Shenzhen Weibang Technology Co., Ltd. Address: 1st Floor, Building 9, Tianliao Industrial Zone A, Taoyuan Street, Nanshan District, Shenzhen City, Guangdong Province.

Legal Representative: Liu Baochun, General Manager of the company.

Re-Applicants Li Jianyi and Shenzhen YuanCheng Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as YuanCheng Company), in the case of dispute over patent ownership with the Respondent Shenzhen Weibang Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Weibang Company), disagree with the civil judgment (2018) Yue Min Zhong No. 2262 rendered by the Guangdong High People's Court and have applied to this Court for retrial. This Court lawfully formed a collegial panel to conduct the review, which has now concluded.

Li Jianyi and YuanCheng Company apply for retrial on the following grounds: (1) Li Jianyi and YuanCheng Company are able to provide new evidence proving that Weibang Company had completed the research and development of the intravenous drug dispensing device before Li Jianyi commenced employment and had entered the process of prototype production and manufacturing. Approximately three months after Weibang Company completed the research and development of the intravenous drug dispensing device, Li Jianyi joined Weibang Company and did not participate in the research and development work of the intravenous drug dispensing device. The evidence provided by Weibang Company concerning Li Jianyi's participation in the research and development work of the intravenous drug dispensing device does not constitute truly necessary documents relating to the research and development and lacks relevance. (2) The first instance judgment found that the patent in question was a service invention-creation, which constitutes an error in fact finding. a. The patent in question is not related to Li Jianyi's duties or the tasks assigned by Weibang Company. b. The evidence provided by Weibang Company only proves that Li Jianyi engaged in research and development management work at Weibang Company, not technical research and development work. c. The few drawings provided by Weibang Company are not necessary documents relating to technical research and development and lack relevance. d. The first instance court, based on emails exchanged between Li Jianyi and research and development personnel submitted by Weibang Company, found that Li Jianyi participated in specific research and development work, which constitutes an error in fact finding. e. Li Jianyi's position was Production and Manufacturing Director, mainly responsible for the mass production of equipment. f. Some of the emails did not contain any technical research and development data. As for the email dated April 9, 2013, Weibang Company did not provide further evidence to prove that Li Jianyi received the email and participated in the discussion meeting. g. Li Jianyi was only engaged in research and development management. The first instance court, based on the Leave Request Form, Purchase Request Form, and Order Form submitted by Weibang Company, found that Li Jianyi participated in specific research and development work, which constitutes an error in fact finding. (3) The patent in question does not constitute a "service invention-creation" as defined in Article 6 of the Patent Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 12 of the Implementing Regulations of the Patent Law of the People's Republic of China. Weibang Company also lacks conclusive evidence to prove that the patent in question constitutes "an invention-creation made by an employee in performing tasks other than those assigned by the unit to which the employee belongs." (4) Weibang Company's patent CN102847473 (hereinafter referred to as the 473 patent) was already published on January 2, 2013. Compared with the 473 patent, the technical features of the patent in question are different, and the patent in question possesses innovativeness. The first instance court found that the two patents have certain similarities and relevance, and further inferred that they have a close relationship, concluding that it is highly probable that the patent in question was improved on the basis of the 473 patent, which lacks factual evidence and legal basis. The second instance judgment found that the technical fields involved in the two patents are the same, and the differences in technical solutions do not constitute valid evidence that Li Jianyi independently completed the patent in question, which does not comply with the relevant provisions of the Patent Law. (5) The second instance judgment's finding that "it cannot be inferred that Li Jianyi possessed the ability to independently complete the invention" lacks factual and legal basis. Before joining Weibang Company, Li Jianyi already had relevant experience with intravenous drug dispensing devices. In summary, the applicants request this Court to revoke the second instance judgment and order Weibang Company to bear all litigation costs for the first instance, second instance, and retrial.

Weibang Company submitted its opinions, stating that in a dispute over patent ownership, it is not necessary to compare the technical features of the patent in question with those of the original employer's technology one by one; it is only required that the invention-creation be "related" to the duties performed by the employee at the original employer, and then the patent in question can be determined to belong to the original employer. The second instance court found that the patent in question is "related" to the duties or tasks assigned by Weibang Company to Li Jianyi, which is clear and correct. The evidence submitted by Li Jianyi when applying for retrial is irrelevant to the purpose of proof and should not be admitted.

Li Jianyi and YuanCheng Company submitted the following evidence during the retrial review:

1. The testimony of witness He Liangbing, used to prove that before Li Jianyi joined Weibang Company on September 24, 2012, Weibang Company had already completed the research and development of the automatic intravenous drug dispensing device and had entered the process of prototype production and manufacturing;

2. "Product System Design," which is a textbook of the "Twelfth Five-Year" planning for the industrial design major in ordinary higher education institutions;

3. "Lean Management of R&D Position Responsibilities and Assessment," which is a research achievement of the Ministry of Education Humanities and Social Sciences project "Research on the Structure and Measurement of Tacit Knowledge of Enterprise R&D Personnel";

4. "Lean Management of R&D Management Processes and Nodes," which is a research achievement of the Ministry of Education Humanities and Social Sciences project "Research on the Structure and Measurement of Tacit Knowledge of Enterprise R&D Personnel";

5. "Lean Design of R&D Management Documents and Schemes," which is a research achievement of the Ministry of Education Humanities and Social Sciences project "Research on the Structure and Measurement of Tacit Knowledge of Enterprise R&D Personnel";

6. "Lean Design of R&D Management Systems and Forms," which is a research achievement of the Ministry of Education Humanities and Social Sciences project "Research on the Structure and Measurement of Tacit Knowledge of Enterprise R&D Personnel";

7. "Kanban Management and Q&A for R&D Departments, Practical Essence Edition";

8. The status of patents applied for and granted to Li Jianyi from 2015 to 2018, intended to prove that the 16 patents Li Jianyi applied for and was granted during this period are all related to intravenous drug dispensing device technology, including intelligent dispensing robots, micro ampoule dispensing machines, and micro vial dispensing machines.

9. "Search for the Patent in Question," "Search for Weibang Company's Comparison Patent," "Statistics of Weibang Company's Patent Inventors," and "Statistics of Weibang Company's Patent Application Dates," downloaded from the website of the National Intellectual Property Administration, intended to prove that before Li Jianyi's employment, Weibang Company had already completed the research and development of the intravenous drug dispensing device.

Upon review, this Court finds that the above evidence 2-7 cannot prove the facts of this case and lacks relevance to this case. As for whether the other evidence can achieve the purpose of proof, this Court will determine it in light of the relevant facts found in the first and second instance trials.

After review, this Court holds that, based on the applicant's grounds for applying for retrial, the focus of the dispute in this case is whether the patent in question constitutes a service invention-creation made by Li Jianyi during his employment at Weibang Company.

Article 6 of the Patent Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Patent Law) stipulates: "An invention-creation made by a person in the execution of the tasks of the entity to which he belongs, or made mainly by using the material and technical conditions of the entity, is a service invention-creation. For a service invention-creation, the right to apply for a patent belongs to the entity." Article 12, paragraph 1, item (3) of the Implementing Regulations of the Patent Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Implementing Regulations of the Patent Law) stipulates that "an invention-creation made within one year after the employee's retirement, transfer from the original unit, or termination of the labor or personnel relationship, which is related to the duties performed by the employee at the original unit or the tasks assigned by the original unit" constitutes a service invention-creation.

Invention-creation is a complex intellectual endeavor, which inevitably requires the input or support of necessary resources such as funds, technology, and research and development personnel, and bears corresponding risks. When identifying a service invention-creation related to a departed employee, it is necessary to protect the legitimate rights of the original employer over scientific and technological achievements that are truly service invention-creations, to encourage and support innovation-driven development, but at the same time, the interpretation of "related invention-creation" provided in Article 12, paragraph 1, item (3) of the Implementing Regulations of the Patent Law should not be overly broad, so as to unduly restrict the normal flow of research and development personnel, or restrict the legitimate participation or initiation of new technical research and development activities by research and development personnel at a new unit, in the absence of legal provisions or contractual agreements such as non-competition agreements. Therefore, in determining whether the invention-creation in question falls within the category of "related invention-creation" as stipulated in Article 12, paragraph 1, item (3) of the Implementing Regulations of the Patent Law, attention should be paid to maintaining the balance of interests among the original employer, the departed employee, and the new employer of the departed employee, and the following factors shall be comprehensively considered: first, the specific content of the duties performed by the departed employee at the original employer or the tasks assigned by the original employer, including job responsibilities, authority, and the technical information related to the patent in question that can be accessed, controlled, or obtained. Second, the specific circumstances of the patent in question, including its technical field, the technical problem solved, the purpose and technical effect of the invention, the scope of protection defined by the claims, the "substantive characteristics" of the patent in question relative to the prior art, etc., as well as the relationship between the patent in question and the duties or tasks assigned by the original employer. Third, whether the original employer has conducted technical research and development activities related to the patent in question, or whether it has a legal source for the relevant technology. Fourth, whether the right holder and the inventor can provide a reasonable explanation for the research and development process or the technical source of the patent in question, and the relevant factors include the complexity of the technical solution of the patent in question, the required research and development investment, and whether the right holder and the inventor possess the corresponding knowledge, experience, skills, or material and technical conditions, and whether there is evidence proving that they have carried out relevant research and development activities.

Based on the facts found by the first and second instance courts and the evidence submitted by the retrial applicants, this Court makes the following determination on the focus of the dispute in this case, centering on the four factors mentioned above:

First, regarding the specific content of Li Jianyi's duties or assigned tasks during his employment at Weibang Company. Firstly, during his employment at Weibang Company, Li Jianyi served as the Production and Manufacturing Director, directly engaged in research and development management of drug dispensing equipment and devices. In his application for retrial, he also acknowledged that he engaged in "research and development management work." Secondly, during his employment at Weibang Company, Li Jianyi signed on purchase request forms of the research and development department in the capacity of Department Manager, and signed on the review column of multiple technical drawings that were closely related to the technology of the patent in question and were stamped with "Controlled Document." Thirdly, Li Jianyi repeatedly participated in meetings or discussions within Weibang Company related to the technical research and development of automatic drug dispensing equipment and devices, and also received research and development test status reports via email, arranged test work, and raised corresponding requirements for research and development tests. In summary, based on the duties or tasks Li Jianyi performed during his employment at Weibang Company, he was able to directly access, control, and obtain technical information within Weibang Company closely related to the technical research and development of automatic drug dispensing equipment and devices, and such information was not ordinary knowledge, experience, or skills in the field. Therefore, the duties or tasks Li Jianyi performed at Weibang Company were closely related to the technology of the patent in question. This Court does not support the grounds for retrial submitted by Li Jianyi, including his claim that he only managed research and development and did not participate in Weibang Company's research and development work on intravenous drug dispensing devices, and that the relevant evidence from Weibang Company did not constitute truly necessary documents for research and development.

Second, regarding the specific circumstances of the patent in question and its relationship with Li Jianyi's duties or assigned tasks. Firstly, the patent in question relates to "Automatic Intravenous Drug Dispensing Device and Swing-Type Turntable Drug Dispensing Device," and the technical problem addressed is: "1. The labor intensity of pharmacists' hands is very high, allowing only short-term work; 2. Due to differences in skills among pharmacists and the inability to enforce fixed dispensing locations, the properties of dispensed drugs are unstable; 3. Chemotherapeutic drugs pose a significant health hazard to pharmacists." The technical effect achieved is: "The present invention uses a robot to complete the entire preparation process of intravenous drugs, uses mechatronic integration to control the accuracy of drug dosage, and improves the quality of drug preparation; medical staff only need to pre-load drug bottles into the turntable work plate and the mother liquid rack, and finally remove the prepared mother liquid bottle, greatly reducing the labor intensity of medical staff; for the preparation of hazardous drugs (such as chemotherapy drugs), since pharmacists can avoid direct contact with the drug bottles, using isolation tools to clamp and remove the drug bottles can significantly reduce health damage from chemotherapy drug liquids." Claim 1 of the granted patent in question mainly includes a base, a turntable worktable, several bottle clamps for fixing drug bottles, a clamp seat, a turntable seat, a turntable transmission mechanism and a turntable motor, a backlight and a vision sensor respectively arranged on both sides of the turntable worktable near the rear side, a robot, a clamp body, an infusion pump, an infusion tube, a needle clamp seat, a needle clamp head, a front and rear swing plate, a lifting mechanism, and other components. Secondly, the 473 patent filed by Weibang Company on September 4, 2012, is titled "Drug Dispensing Method of Automatic Drug Dispensing System and Automatic Drug Dispensing System," and the technical problem addressed is: "The method of preparing drugs in hospitals is performed manually by medical personnel. ... During operation, the labor intensity of medical personnel is high, and some drugs are toxic, posing a significant threat to the safety of medical personnel." The invention purpose is: "To overcome the shortcomings of the above prior art, and provide a drug dispensing method of an automatic drug dispensing system and an automatic drug dispensing system, which can achieve automatic drug dispensing, and medical personnel do not need to prepare drug liquids manually, greatly reducing the labor intensity of medical personnel and helping to ensure the health and safety of medical personnel." The technical effect achieved is: "To provide a drug dispensing method of an automatic drug dispensing system and an automatic drug dispensing system, which can quickly complete the preparation of multiple groups of drug liquids, improve drug dispensing efficiency, greatly reduce the labor intensity of medical personnel, and help to ensure the health and safety of medical personnel." The description of the 473 patent also discloses the specific structures and drawings of components such as "Drug Liquid Input Shaking Device," "Clamping Components," "Infusion Hose Loading, Transfer, and Drug Liquid Dispensing Device," "Ampoule Breaking Device," "Mother Liquid Bottle Clamping Device," "Mother Liquid Bottle," and "Input Turntable Capable of Holding Multiple Drug Bottles at Once." Comparing the patent in question with Weibang Company's 473 patent, the technical problems addressed, the invention purposes, and the technical effects are substantially the same, and the technical solutions of the two patents are highly correlated. The second instance court, based on the examination opinions of the patent in question and the citation patent search, found that the 473 patent constitutes a document that can independently affect the novelty or inventiveness of the claims of the patent in question, which is not improper. Thirdly, among the drawings provided by Weibang Company related to Li Jianyi's duties, components closely related to the patent in question are involved, such as "Input Module New Cover," "Shaw Compound Needle Assembly," "Peristaltic Pump Infusion Needle," "Peristaltic Pump Upper Cover Connection Plate Test," "Assembly," "Left Clamping Jaw," "Right Clamping Jaw," "Manipulator Clamping Jaw 1," and "Manipulator Clamping Jaw 2." These drawings are stamped with "Controlled Document" and bear Li Jianyi's signature in the "Review" column. Fourthly, in the emails exchanged between Li Jianyi and relevant staff of Weibang Company, the discussions directly relate to research and development activities closely connected to the technical solutions of the patent in question, such as turntable grasping claws, mother liquid feeding schemes, and ampoule breaking tests. In summary, the patent in question is closely related to the duties or tasks Li Jianyi performed at Weibang Company.

Furthermore, Weibang Company's technical research and development in the field of automatic intravenous drug dispensing equipment has been ongoing. Weibang Company was established in 2002, and its business scope includes the research and development, manufacturing, sales, and after-sales service of hospital intravenous drug preparation series robot products and related preparation center equipment. Between February 2010 and July 2016, it applied for more than 60 patents relating to medical equipment, methods, and systems, of which 44 were applied for before Li Jianyi joined Weibang Company, and multiple patents relate to automatic drug dispensing devices. Therefore, this Court does not support the grounds for retrial submitted by Li Jianyi, based on evidence 1 and 9 submitted to this Court, claiming that Weibang Company had completed the research and development of the intravenous drug dispensing device before his employment, and that the patent in question does not constitute a service invention-creation.

Finally, regarding whether Li Jianyi and YuanCheng Company can provide a reasonable explanation for the research and development process or technical source of the patent in question. According to the specification of the patent in question, it relates to "Automatic Intravenous Drug Dispensing Device and Swing-Type Turntable Drug Dispensing Device," with 13 pages of drawings and approximately 60 components. The technical solution is complex and the research and development difficulty is high. Li Jianyi, as the sole inventor of the patent in question, applied for the patent in his own name alone less than three months after leaving Weibang Company, and could not provide a reasonable explanation for the technical research and development process or the technical source, which is inconsistent with common sense. Moreover, according to the determination of the second instance court, based on the patent search webpage printouts and the self-made summary table of patent status submitted by Li Jianyi in the first instance, Li Jianyi, as an inventor, first applied for the patent in question and the utility model patent No. 201320416724.5 titled "Automatic Intravenous Drug Dispensing Device and Drug Dispensing Device Using Vision Sensor" on July 12, 2013. Before that, the evidence in this case cannot prove that Li Jianyi had the knowledge and ability to independently research and develop the technical solution of the patent in question.

In summary, considering all relevant facts of this case and the evidence submitted by Li Jianyi and YuanCheng Company to this Court, the first and second instance courts correctly found that the patent in question constitutes a service invention-creation made by Li Jianyi during his employment at Weibang Company. The grounds for retrial submitted by Li Jianyi and YuanCheng Company cannot be established.

Pursuant to Article 204, paragraph 1 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 395, paragraph 2 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the order is as follows:

The retrial applications of Li Jianyi and Shenzhen YuanCheng Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. are rejected.

Presiding Judge: Du Weike

Judge: Wu Rong

Judge: Zhang Lingling

December 31, 2019
